slides.texte_overlay:
7 unglamorous habits that make
you way more attractive in your 20s
Going for a walk every evening. No phone, twenty minutes. It clears your head, improves your sleep, and makes you the calm guy instead of the stressed one.
Ironing your shirts the night before. Five minutes, and you walk out looking sharp instead of rushed. People notice a man who prepares, even for small things.
Reading before bed. A real book, ten pages. It makes you calmer, sharper and better at conversation, and nothing looks more attractive than a man who reads.
Stretching for ten minutes a day. Better posture, fewer aches, easier movement. A body that moves well looks confident and at ease long before you ever say a word.
Learning something small every morning. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and a curious man always has something interesting to say at dinner.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. A curious man always has something interesting to say at dinner.

slides.texte_overlay: Fixing things instead of replacing them. A loose handle, a wobbly chair, a flat bike tyre. Being handy is old school, practical and quietly very attractive.
Writing down your goals every Sunday. Three things for the week, nothing fancy. A man with direction is magnetic, because he knows where his life is going.
